visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An orange and white tabby cat is positioned on a white office desk, repeatedly batting at a Baby Yoda (Grogu) figurine with its right paw. A person's hand enters the frame periodically to adjust or pull the figurine away. The background features a large computer monitor displaying a file-cluttered desktop in a bright indoor office setting. (2) The perspective shifts to a close-up where the cat is lying flat on the desk, resting its chin directly on top of the owner's hand as it grips a white computer mouse. The cat looks upward with wide eyes, its whiskers twitching slightly against the white mouse surface. (3) The cat is standing near the base of the monitor, investigating a white USB cable. It bats at the cable and then turns its attention to a tissue box, pulling pieces of white tissue out with its mouth and paws. The lighting is consistent and bright. (4) The cat is seen behind a transparent acrylic partition on the desk. It attempts to play with a small slip of paper wedged under the glass. Finally, the cat crouches and successfully crawls through the narrow gap underneath the partition. (5) The video concludes with a solid pink screen featuring white centered text for a brand logo.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern home office desk equipped with a large iMac-style computer, an Apple Magic Keyboard, a Magic Mouse, a Star Wars Grogu figurine, a wooden tissue box, and various stationery items. The room has neutral-colored walls and bright, even lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, bouncy synthesizer-based BGM begins with a steady 4/4 electronic drum beat. A comical 'bubble pop' sound effect is perfectly synchronized with the start of the cat's physical batting motion. The mix is clean with high spectral brightness. (2) The upbeat music continues at a constant tempo. A descending pitch-bend or 'slide' SFX occurs as the cat rests its chin, adding a humorous layer to the acoustic profile. There is no detectable human speech or room noise. (3) Rapid-fire percussive 'ding' and 'click' sound effects are introduced, acting as auditory punctuation for the cat's interaction with the cables and the rustling of the tissue box. The BGM remains the primary melodic carrier. (4) The playful synth melody loops. A soft 'whoosh' and a metallic-like 'pling' SFX mark the transition of the cat moving through the gap in the partition. The audio design maintains a high density of post-production accents. (5) A final, short melodic brand jingle with a bright, resonant timbre signals the end of the clip, fading out quickly into silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Action Variation -> Climax -> Branding
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to entertain and engage an audience by showcasing a series of adorable and mischievous behaviors of a pet cat in a domestic office setting. By using fast-paced editing and comedic sound effects, it highlights the relatable struggle of working while a pet demands attention.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The branding present is for the content creator's own channel ('好味小姐'), not a third-party product placement.
